Scaled source, fixed destination clip, overlap snapshot, bounded SRC and unchanged DST pixels. Rotation, reflection and shear explicitly fail: UnsupportedOperationException in stock J2CL, InternalError in the JDK. Zero-area requests are harmless.

Center image: null operation preserves original colored/transparent quadrants. Right image: non-null rescale produces white opaque quadrants and preserves transparency. Graphics transform and clip remain unchanged.
Left image: rotated 90 degrees and scaled 1.5x under a fixed clip; colored and clipped-away quadrant pixels, unchanged graphics transform/clip, and true return.
Top-right tile: natural size with cyan replacing the transparent quadrant; opaque quadrants are unchanged; returns true.
Top-left tile: natural 40x40 size; blue/green/yellow quadrants and transparent quadrant retaining red; returns true.
Bottom-left tile: 60x60 scaled placement and cyan replacement of transparency; returns true.
Top-center tile: scales to 60x60; quadrant pixels land at scaled positions and transparency retains red; returns true.
Bottom-right tile: reversed source endpoints mirror all four quadrants, with cyan behind transparency; returns true.
Bottom-center tile: reversed destination endpoints mirror all four source quadrants, including transparent red; returns true.
The vertical green line expands to the expected width under nonuniform scaling and remains bounded by the fixed clip. Custom Paint also colors the stroked line outline.
Scaled default/explicit widths, butt/round/square cap pixels, dash gaps and custom-stroke output in the first primitive tile.
Second primitive tile and the larger closed rectangle: phase continues around corners and a custom stroke receives the entire rectangle once.
Third tile: curved outline stroke and dash-gap pixels, plus filled bounds from the custom stroke.
Fourth tile: stroked top and left dash gap, empty center with BasicStroke, filled center with a custom stroke.
Fifth tile: 360-degree arc stroke and right-side dash gap, empty/filled center distinguishes BasicStroke and the custom stroke.
Dash phase crosses segment boundaries; miter/round/bevel and miter-limit pixels match JDK; the custom stroke sees one complete path.
Seventh tile: closed triangle has blue stroke and red dash-gap/interior pixels; custom-stroke bounds fill the center.
Eighth tile exercises the Polygon overload: dashed rectangle stroke/gap/interior pixels and one complete custom-stroke call.
Selected widths, dash phase, caps, joins and custom outlines have visible effects; a child stroke does not change its parent.
Identity checks retain the supplied BasicStroke/custom Stroke before and after drawing and child disposal; the page reports successful checks.
Shape interiors, clipping and untouched bounding-box corners; tiled texture and custom contexts; transformed/cyclic/color-space gradients and all 12 AlphaComposite rules.
Paint affects fill and stroke pixels; null is ignored, non-color paint retains the current color, and setColor replaces paint. Canvas native text rejects arbitrary paints explicitly.
Paint identity is retained through null assignment, failures and image/copy operations; setColor is reflected by getPaint.

All 12 rules affect only the source footprint; CLEAR ignores source alpha; SRC preserves transparent source pixels; global alpha and DST have observable effects. Null and unsupported custom composites leave state unchanged.
Reports each selected rule and retained composite identity after rejection; WebAWT rejects custom Composite and JDK accepts it.
Selected font and 12/24px sizes determine visible bar widths; null preserves the current font and child font changes are isolated.
Reports selected font identity before and after null selection, explicit metrics queries and child disposal.
Current-font widths control checked bar endpoints on both backends; pinned font agrees with native browser advances within 0.05px and JDK samples within 2px. Metrics retain their FRC snapshot.
Explicit 12px font metrics produce shorter blue bars without changing the selected 24px font; metrics retain the requested font.
Retains scale/shear and explicit text AA/fractional hints, excludes translation, returns defensive transforms and immutable snapshots; later changes affect only new contexts.

Integer-baseline whole-run glyph pixels, rotation/scale/shear, font transforms, clipping, half alpha and CLEAR; native-oracle pixels and shared JDK ink regions. Modern-browser rasterization is required for BufferedImage; attributed runs, glyph outlines and hint parity are not covered. Canvas rejects source-unbounded text composites explicitly.

Fractional baselines and combining accents retain glyph coverage; transformed and clipped floating-position strings agree with the independent native oracle. Modern-browser rasterization is required for BufferedImage; attributed runs, glyph outlines and hint parity are not covered. Canvas rejects source-unbounded text composites explicitly.

Only the requested AV plus accented-e char slice is painted; a separate visible row and native-oracle comparison establish the inherited overload.
